help.aria: Get help from a staff member
help.title: Need a hand?
help.notified: A staff member has been notified and is coming to help you.
help.emergencyBody: If someone has severe chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting, or is at risk right now — don't wait.
trust: A pharmacist reviews every result. You can stop anytime.
id.title: Welcome
id.lead: Sign in to begin. A practitioner is on hand throughout.
id.name: Your name
id.namePh: Scan card / QR, or type your name
con.title: Before we start
con.lead: This assistant supports a pharmacist — it does not replace a doctor, and a practitioner reviews the result. You can stop anytime. If your case is urgent we'll retrieve your hospital record. Your result may be shared with the pharmacy, hospital, or paramedics as needed.
con.teachLabel: In your own words, what is this and can you stop it?
con.teachPh: e.g. it's a helper that asks me questions, a real person checks it, and I can stop whenever…
con.teachNote: Teach-back: we record your understanding (consent evidence). If you're unsure, ask for help — you'll go to a person instead.
ctx.title: What brings you in?
ctx.lead: A one-line reason for your visit. No medical record is opened yet.
ctx.label: Presenting complaint
ctx.ph: e.g. chest discomfort for the last hour
in.title: A few details
in.lead: Type, tap to speak, or use a quick answer below. Tell us your medicines, conditions and allergies — this keeps triage safe without opening your full record.
in.label: Current medicines, conditions, allergies
in.ph: e.g. on warfarin; penicillin allergy; type-2 diabetes
tri.title: Triage interview
tri.lead: A guided, step-by-step assessment — type or tap the mic to speak. medpsy thinks before each reply, so a turn can take a few seconds.
tri.mainPh: Type or tap the mic to speak your main symptom…
tri.answerPh: Type or tap the mic to speak your answer…
tri.handsfreePh: Listening after each question — or type to take over…
tri.noText: No answer came back — please try again, or use “Conclude now”.
his.title: Hospital record
his.routineLead: Routine case — the full record is not opened (data minimisation). What you told us already informed the triage.
his.urgentLead: Urgent case — retrieve the official record and re-check with your medicines, conditions and allergies.
rt.title: Where this goes
rt.destRed: Emergency department — alerting the team now
val.title: Practitioner sign-off
val.lead: The on-shift clinician reviews, edits and confirms — the human-in-the-loop check.
bil.title: Coding & billing
bil.lead: From the validated diagnosis — not the AI draft.
